title: Concept: Unmasked value returned beside its masked twin
description: A full account or card value next to a masked copy of the same field in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: When both forms ship in one payload, the masking is decorative: any client, log or cache that keeps the response also keeps the full value.
applicability: Deployments that render a full account or card value next to a masked copy of the same field into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: When both forms ship in one payload, the masking is decorative: any client, log or cache that keeps the response also keeps the full value.
